concerns.text: The descriptor‑engineering step (Phase 3) does not reference the `processed_data.schema.yaml` contract that defines the expected structure of the descriptor matrix. Adding an explicit validation against this schema would close the gap between the plan and the data‑model.

The model‑training and evaluation phases (Phases 4‑5) produce performance metrics but the plan never mentions validating `metrics.json` against `metrics.schema.yaml`. Including a schema‑validation step would ensure consistency with the contracts.
